title: Tiny fixture flight
description: Four-camera fixture flying east at 4 m/s. Splats are unprojected depth, plus a synthetic cable across the corridor and an orange actor moving east at 1.5 m/s. POST /api/v1/infer runs the network instead of this bake.
notes: SH degree 0 matches the surface color. A linear lobe points at source_sun.
The sun slider rotates that lobe. It does not move the baked glare image.
Predict glare calls POST /api/v1/infer with the new sun.
The cable is absent from the RGB frames. It exists for the wire overlay and the collision query.
